title: Too stylish Seville
text: Great experience! Apart from the fact that Seville is a superb city to discover, the proposed route is great, not too long or too short... It made us discover places we would never have gone clear. Audios are full of anecdotes and interesting information. Being able to visit whenever we want and at our own pace is really nice. I recommend with my eyes closed 🤩
author: alexis_c

text: Very good experience that makes us see the main monuments of Seville. Announcing the monuments at the beginning of the site would allow you to enjoy the monument a little more.
